name: com.reromanlee.meshoutline
description: Constant-width outlines for any mesh, skinned mesh or whole hierarchy, with zero per-frame cost. Outline meshes are baked ahead of time into a shared cache and drawn with a stencil mask and a smoothed-normal extrusion, so duplicates, prefabs, undo and runtime spawning just work. URP and Built-in.

samples.description: Outline what's under the pointer and keep clicked objects selected. Also shows a multi-part prop, a LOD group, a bending skinned mesh and an X-ray outline. Works in URP and Built-in, with either input system.
